# Discrete Distributions

Discrete distributions describe phenomena with distinct, separate outcomes (typically integer values).

## Finite Support

These distributions have a finite number of possible outcomes.

- [Bernoulli](bernoulli.qmd)
- [Binomial](binomial.qmd)
- [Hypergeometric](hypergeometric.qmd)
- [Beta-Binomial](beta_binomial.qmd)
- [Poisson Binomial](poisson_binomial.qmd)
- [Negative Binomial](negative_binomial.qmd)
- [Negative Hypergeometric](negative_hypergeometric.qmd)

## Infinite Support

These distributions have an infinite (but countable) number of possible outcomes.

- [Poisson](poisson.qmd)
- [Geometric](geometric.qmd)
- [Beta Negative Binomial](beta_negative_binomial.qmd)
